entities.summary: Helena Grozer, née Havelková is a Czech beach volleyball player. She was a member of the Czech Republic women's national team. She competed at the 2014–15 CEV Women's Champions League in Szczecin, Poland, claiming the silver medal. She is married to György Grozer.
